why: Every name and claim checks out against the repo. bin/csv2json.js ignores its arguments and calls parse(readFileSync(0,'utf8')), so it always splits on commas. src/parse.js has `parse(text, sep = ',')`. The quoted current output `[{"a\tb":"1\t2"}]` matches what the comma split gives for that input. README.md documents only CSV usage. test/csv.test.js and `npm test` (node --test) exist. The CRLF and unchanged-CSV expectations are consistent with the `/\r?\n/` split, and `a\tb,c` produces `{"a\tb":"1\t2","c":"3"}`. The --tsv flag and its README section are what the issue asks to create.
